headline: Split upgrade agent guide: new shared duplicate-check and delivery checklist
summary: New shared.mdx holds the duplicate-PR checks and commit/PR delivery steps that every agentic upgrade guide now hands off to. It is bundled and fed to the upgrade agent as instructions, so it controls what the agent does: stop on duplicates, how it commits, and when it opens a draft PR. About half the text moved from the deleted agentic-upgrade.mdx; the Future Defaults and per-default commit grouping rules are new.
risk_signals: agent instructions control commits and PR publication
duplicate-check stop condition now shared across all guides
focus: Delivery rules (one commit per crossed major, Future Defaults grouped by default) match what the three per-policy guides expect
Duplicate-check stop condition still runs before any file change, since the prompt now points to this file first
Future Defaults wording applies correctly when no version change occurs and no version commit exists
reason: Docs-only file, but it is shipped as runtime instructions for an AI agent that commits and opens PRs, so a reviewer should judge the wording.
